info.bio:
Después de la disolución  temporal de Bauhaus en el 1983  Tones on Tail fue el  siguiente proyecto musical pensado a principio como  una banda pararela  .
 Compuesta por Daniel Ash, Kevin Haskins y Glen Campling. La banda se creo  en el ´82 y termino en el ´84.

Si bien la banda tuvo un tiempo corto de vida, y como Daniel Ash siempre  era inquieto y viendo que su banda de siempre Bauhaus desaparecía, hacía desaparecer también esta y creo  Love And Rockets.

scenes.name: Nueva York: Storm Rave, Joey Beltram y Moby
scenes.book: Techno Rebels: The Renegades of Electronic Funk
scenes.author: Dan Sicko
scenes.desc: Alrededor de su tienda Groove de Brooklyn, los hermanos Frankie Bones y Adam X organizaron las Storm Rave, con el fanzine Under One Sky de Heather Heart; hacia 1992 la escena incluía a Joey Beltram y Mundo Muzique, que como Second Phase grabaron el himno rave «Mentasm» (1991). En Manhattan, Richard Melville Hall, Moby, despuntó en Instinct con «Mobility» (1990) y su cara B «Go», sobre el tema de Laura de Twin Peaks, número diez británico en 1991 y contrato con Mute y Elektra. Su persona (cristiano, vegano) eclipsó su música, con curiosidades como «Thousand» a mil bpm, hasta que Play (1999), licenciado tema a tema, vendió diez millones.

podcast.body: Tones on Tail had a short-lived career, existing only from 1982 to 1984, during which they released one album and three EPs. "Tons on Tale only existed from 1982 to 1984."

podcast.title: Love and Rockets' Success
podcast.body: Love and Rockets, the successor band, achieved substantial success, including the single "So Alive," which reached number one in Canada and number three on the U.S. Top 40 charts. "And they had a really good run with many big singles, including So Alive, which was a number one single in Canada and a number three single in the U.S. and I'm talking the Tom Fordy Charts."

podcast.title: Musical Appeal and Audience
podcast.body: While the band released other singles, none achieved the widespread recognition of "Go!", especially within Alt Rock radio and dance clubs that catered to an audience with a preference for dark clothing. "But nothing was anywhere as big as the one we're about to hear, especially on Alt Rock Radio and in Dance Clubs, especially the kind that catered to people wearing a lot of black clothing."

podcast.title: Reconstitution as Love and Rockets
podcast.body: After Tones on Tail ceased activity, the group was reconstituted under the name Love and Rockets, which featured the members of Bauhaus with the exception of singer Peter Murphy. This new iteration went on to have a successful run with multiple significant singles. "When Tons on Tale Lost Steam, the group was reconstituted under the name Love and Rockets, which was Bajaos minus singer Peter Murphy."

xref.title: Post-Breakup Projects
xref.body: After the band Bauhaus "splintered," its members went on to form other significant groups, including Tones on Tail and Love and Rockets. Additionally, the individual members, Peter Murphy, David J, and Daniel Ash, pursued solo careers. "Bauhaus splintered into tones on tail and loving rockets and indirectly gave us Peter Murphy, David J and Daniel Ash."
